---
name: New source suggestion
about: Suggest an official feed we don't use yet
title: "[Source] "
labels: new-source
---

**Publisher**
Which official body publishes it? (statistics office, ministry, police force…)

**Feed / dataset link**
Direct link to the machine-readable feed (API, CSV, SDMX, Atom…) if one exists.

**What it would measure**
The figures it contains and how often it's updated.

**Country / topic**
Which country page or topic it belongs to.

Note: if there is no machine-readable feed, we'd rather show "no live feed" than scrape or estimate — but tell us anyway, it may still be worth linking.
